decision_rationale: OCellus is presented as a new multimodal language-model framework with a shared backbone, natural-language interface, and generated explanations. The evidence supports a primary model paper rather than a wrapper.
evidence_snippet: multi-task language model; Planner-Router-Verifier natural-language interface; generates natural-language explanations of its own outputs

decision_rationale: The visible record is a literature-derived network/ODE pipeline using PubTator3 publications plus an LLM, but it does not show a central generative text-bio model. Wrapper-style use is the safest reading.
evidence_snippet: gene regulatory relationships were obtained from the pre-annotated PubTator3 table; integrated with a large language model (LLM)

decision_rationale: Unify combines scRNA-seq with language-model embeddings as auxiliary features for transfer learning and perturbation prediction. That is wrapper-style feature fusion rather than a generative text-bio model.
evidence_snippet: combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models; prediction of perturbation responses across species

decision_rationale: scMIR is a vision-language foundation model with paired microscopy images and structured textual captions plus text-guided alignment. The generative mechanism is not explicit enough to resolve beyond unclear.
evidence_snippet: paired single-cell images and structured textual captions; text-guided cross-modal alignment; self-supervised image reconstruction

decision_rationale: CellDuality fine-tunes an existing LLM with SFT and self-supervised RLVR over textual biological prompts and outputs. That fits an application wrapper rather than a new foundation model.
evidence_snippet: all inputs to the LLM are constructed as textual prompts; output is a textual response y, generated autoregressively according to the policy
